_note: V1 hand annotation of bundle_real_ared_dap, third real document, by Claude. Written before running any router against it. All spans verified verbatim against the pipeline's own extraction.
_source: NTRS 20140011878, Digital Astronaut Project ARED VV&C conference poster
_why_this_document: The first two annotated documents are both decomposed_7009a journal articles. This one is a different published vocabulary (rollup_7009a, 8 factors, Verification and Validation as single rolled-up scores) and a different genre (a one-page poster, not a paper). If routing only works on journal prose, this is where that shows.
_degraded_source: A poster has more than two columns, so the gutter detector splits it into two and chart axis labels remain interleaved with the bullet text. Several bullets are therefore only partially recoverable, and only spans that survive verbatim are annotated -- the fragments are left out rather than reconstructed. This makes ARED a genuinely harder document, which is the point of including it.
_factor_assignment: Verification and Validation are assigned by which poster section the span appears under (RESULTS: VERIFICATION vs RESULTS: VALIDATION), not by wording. 'Model springs matched data' reads like verification but sits under Validation, where the model is compared to ISS flight data.
